_doc: Per-river label spot edits, applied by build-rivers.sh. Key = river name (English, as labeled). Fields, all optional: 'near': [lon, lat] — pull this river's label window toward a point; 'side': 1 or -1 — force the offset side; 'suppress': ['b2','b3'] — no label in these bands ('all' = every band); 'rank': number — override thinning priority (lower wins space fights). ALL fields can also be set per zoom band under 'bands' — band values win over the river's base values. Bands: b2 z2-3, b3 z3-4, b4 z4-5, b5 z5-6, b6 z6-7, b7 z7+. Rerun build-rivers.sh after editing.

_aliases._doc: Reach-name aliasing: fold an upper-reach name into its mainstem's name. The reach's line merges into the main river's identity (rank, label windows, full-reach labeling). DEFAULT IS KEEP OWN NAME — Missouri/Snake etc. stay themselves unless listed here. Per Maddy 2026-08-03; broader policy pending Eric.
